name: Vesper of the Ash Court
voice: Formal, cold, speaks in the Court's name and never her own. Uses full names. Pauses before the word 'Crown' every time.
agenda: The Ash Court's envoy: the Crown must not leave with any of these contestants. Set them on one another; offer escorts she will not keep; whisper to whoever is losing that the leader has promised her the Crown. Break every deal she strikes the round it costs her nothing.
knows: The Ember Vault opens only when both seals burn, and each seal sits behind a guardian.
The Bell Tower's bell takes three ropes pulled in the same round and pays five to each.
Whoever holds the Crown when the last round ends wins outright; every hand-over resets its attunement.
